arguments.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) AS sets_in_year,
       COUNT(DISTINCT t.setCode) AS sets_with_entries,
       COUNT(t.id) AS entries,
       COUNT(t.translation) AS named_entries,
       SUM(TRIM(t.translation) = '') AS blank_names,
       GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT t.language) AS languages,
       MIN(s.releaseDate) AS first_release,
       MAX(s.releaseDate) AS last_release
FROM sets AS s
LEFT JOIN set_translations AS t ON t.setCode = s.code
WHERE s.releaseDate >= '2020-01-01' AND s.releaseDate < '2021-01-01'

arguments.sql:
SELECT
    s.name,
    s.keyruneCode,
    COUNT(DISTINCT t.language) AS language_count
FROM sets AS s
LEFT JOIN set_translations AS t
    ON t.setCode = s.code
    AND TRIM(t.translation) <> ''
    AND t.language <> 'English'
WHERE s.releaseDate >= '2020-01-01'
  AND s.releaseDate < '2021-01-01'
GROUP BY s.id, s.name, s.keyruneCode
ORDER BY s.name
LIMIT 1000
